name: Systemic root causes re-enter design

turns.user: Investigation confirms that a defect can only be resolved by changing a public consistency contract shared by several services. A reversible mitigation is active. State the next workflow step.

rubric: The assistant stops treating the work as a bounded bug fix.
It invokes designing-changes and carries evidence, constraints, mitigation, and open questions into design.
It permits the reversible mitigation to remain active while the design is considered.
